title: A Ship One Boarded
paragraphs: And so, we moved to Melromarc…
“Hey, Motoyasu-kun…”
“Yes, Father.”
“Huh?”
“Isn’t Sadeena in Melromarc…?”

When we returned to Melromarc, we had an audience with the Queen. The Queen explained that while we were on our expedition to the Dracia Mountains, she and her shadows conducted surprise inspections on the nobles of the country, freeing the slaves and keeping them under the protection of trusted nobles until we returned.

We had mentioned that we were planning to look for big sister’s big sister in Zeltoble, but apparently, Fiancé had also asked the Queen to initiate a search on her end. Since Éclair remembered her name and what she looked like, they quickly found her during the search.

So, by the time we returned, big sister’s big sister was already in Melromarc, and we were able to meet her there. She had been living with the village slaves on the estate of a noble, where she was escorted in her orca beastman form. Since we found her, we came to meet her.
“Big sister Sadeena!”
Big sister threw herself into her big sister’s arms.
“Raphatalia-chan! You’ve grown so much…”
Big sister’s big sister gently embraced her with great care. Big sister’s big sister, I’ve kept my promise.
“It’s been a while, big sister Sadeena.”
Big sister’s friend bowed politely next to Father.
“Rifana-chan, it’s been a while. You’ve been through so much. Are you okay?”
“Yes. The Four… the heroes saved us.”
“Yeah, I’ve heard about it. Thanks to the heroes, this country was prevented from spiraling out of control.”
Big sister’s big sister deeply bowed her head toward us.
“Oink!”
Keel, bursting with excitement, ran up to big sister’s big sister and tried to get her attention. Maybe he should start by transforming from a pig to a dog first?
“So, why have the heroes been dragging Raphatalia-chan and the others around?”
“Well… they rescued us from the faction that was dissatisfied with how things were turning out.”
“Oh… I see.”
Big sister’s big sister looked over at me, Father, Ren, and Itsuki as she said that.
“Thank you so much for everything. Thanks to the heroes, I was able to reunite with everyone.”
“No… we only did what was natural…”
“Even so.”
Hmm? Big sister’s big sister’s reaction seems a little strange.
“Raphatalia-chan… I’ll take care of you in place of your parents.”
“Huh…?”
Big sister tilted her head.
“The village children will be taken care of by the lord and the nobles of Melromarc, so after that’s settled, I’m thinking of leaving in search of a safer land.”
Oh? This feels like an unexpected turn of events.
Wasn’t big sister’s big sister supposed to fight alongside Father as an ally? Once she ensured Big Sister and the slaves were safe, was she planning to leave the country and disappear somewhere?
“N-No!”
Big sister gave that same strained smile as before and refused her big sister.
“We have to… rebuild the village! I decided that on the day I raised that flag!”
With a smile that looked on the verge of tears, big sister conveyed her strong resolve to her big sister.
“If we don’t, father and mother will be sad!”
Even though she looked like she might cry, her face was filled with determination as she declared it.
“I think that’s a good idea… Sadeena… san,” Father muttered softly.
Big sister, following Father’s agreement, held his hand.
“We leveled up the children who had been enslaved so that they could at least protect themselves.”
“Oink!”
Keel chimed in, eagerly explaining something to big sister’s big sister.
“You mean the village’s reconstruction, right? We’ll help out as much as we can.”
“Are we really doing this?”
“Do we even have time for that?”
Itsuki and Ren both raised objections. What’s their problem? In the first world, Father already accomplished this.
“We’re already on board, aren’t we? Ren and Itsuki, you two have gotten pretty close to the village kids.”
“Well…”
“That’s true, but…”
With Father’s persuasion, Ren and Itsuki gave in easily.
“What about you, Motoyasu-kun?”
“Of course, I’ll cooperate. Father did the same in the first world, after all. Besides, based on our experiences so far, having a base of operations we can freely use would be very convenient.”

We had been moving from place to place, but just like in the first world, it might be better to have a base. Last time, we lost it due to an accident, but planting a bioplant this time could also help improve the food situation.
“So, even though we still have our duties as heroes, we’ll help out.”
Big sister’s face lit up with joy at Father’s words.
“Thank you… so much.”
Father looked satisfied with big sister’s smile.
“Well… if that’s what you’ve decided, Raphtalia-chan, I’ll help too.”
“Yeah!”
“Oink!”
“That’s right. This time, we won’t let the bad people take everyone away. We’ll get stronger… and restore a peaceful village!”
Big sister’s friend spoke with determination.
“Then, I’ll be counting on you from now on, Four Holy Heroes.”

And so, big sister’s big sister joined us along with the village’s former slaves. By the end of the day, Father and the others rode in a carriage pulled by the Filolials, heading toward big sister’s village. It was to help with the village’s development. The Queen also promised assistance, and she said she would dispatch soldiers from the demi-human alliance. It’s probably Éclair who will come.
“Four Holy Heroes.”
At that moment, Fiancée raised her hand.
“What is it, Melty-chan?”

“My mother is suggesting that you make an audience with Faubrey. Various countries are making a fuss, claiming that our nation is monopolizing the Four Holy Heroes, and the diplomatic pressure is growing stronger.”

According to Fiancée, this was the situation. Thanks to me, the Queen was able to return to the country, but diplomacy had been neglected as a result. We had managed to buy enough time to grow stronger, but now that we had, it seemed necessary to visit Faubrey at least once and explain the situation before things became too dangerous.
“Ah… right, that was something we needed to do.”
“It was advised that Motoyasu-san shouldn’t go immediately, wasn’t it?”
“I think we’re already strong enough, but is it still not enough?” Ren asked me.
“Wasn’t it because there are a lot of reincarnators and teleporters near Faubrey? That’s part of the concern, right?”
“That’s right. Well, in terms of strength, I think Father and the others could handle it easily now.”
We should be able to explain the situation properly. That Pig King is surprisingly clever, after all.
“But…”

The problem is dealing with the dragon emperor in Takt’s entourage. The key is whether we can take him down before he becomes an imperial dragon. We also need to recruit Assistant and their parent to perform a limit-breaking class-up.
Rival, perhaps? I’d rather avoid running into that guy. I don’t want to see a second Rival emerge.

But… maybe it’s fine to postpone that for now. After all, aside from Yuki-chan and the others, the non-hero forces are still around level 40. We can stretch their potential sufficiently before pushing past level 100. With Ren around, the risk of Assistant’s parent dying is almost zero, and above all, we can’t allow a second Rival to target Father.

Hmm… limit-breaking or Father’s safety. It’s a difficult problem. In any case, it would be best to take down Takt’s dragon. As long as we secure the core stone, we’ll be able to manage the rest somehow.
Or perhaps… should I take it as a gift for Rival’s parent?
“Well, there’s no real problem. But what should we do about the village’s development?”
